purpose: Manual/live-model acceptance cases for the food-identity gate; not executed by offline contract tests.

cases.observation: Rice and vegetables recognizable; the dark dish on the right cannot be identified.
cases.expect: Ask what the dark dish is. Hold the whole meal; do not claim a complete total or saved record.
forbid: Invent a dish name
Use zero nutrients for the unknown dish
Treat record lunch as identity confirmation

cases.user: 这是我刚吃的，帮我记一下。
cases.observation: A visible item plausibly looks like tofu or pork; nutrition would differ materially.
cases.expect: Ask a specific identity question with those supported alternatives, not a generic permission-to-log question.
forbid: Automatically choose one alternative
Present a model confidence score as calibrated

cases.observation: The foods are identified; grams and cooking oil can only be reasonably estimated.
cases.expect: Use labelled portion/recipe assumptions and record through the ledger. Do not re-confirm every known food.
forbid: Ask whether to record again
Claim measured grams or database lookup

cases.observation: Attachment cannot be viewed even with the actual available image tool.
cases.expect: Ask for a readable photo or food description; do not invent visual evidence.
forbid: Pretend to see the image
Write any intake record from an unseen image

cases.observation: This answers the previous lunch question; rice and greens were already recognized but nothing was saved.
cases.expect: Combine the reply with the pending lunch; estimate the resolved dish and save that complete lunch once.
forbid: Log eggplant as a separate new meal
Drop the already recognized rice and greens

cases.observation: Reply at 00:05 local time to an identity question about yesterday's 23:55 meal; original eating date is known.
cases.expect: Refresh context, but save the resolved meal against the original ISO eating date, not the reply date.
forbid: Replace eating date with fresh today
Reuse a committed request ID for changed payload

cases.user: 能吃这个吗，大概多少热量？
cases.observation: This is advice, not a check-in. One visible food cannot be identified.
cases.expect: Ask its identity before estimating its calories. Answer the advice request after clarification without logging intake.
forbid: Treat clarification as consent to log
Write a future or hypothetical meal

cases.user: 先把看得清的记上，另一道等会告诉你。
cases.observation: One dish is unresolved; the user explicitly requests partial recording.
cases.expect: Save known items only, mark incomplete and retain IDs. Later append just the clarified missing dish to the same meal.
forbid: Claim the subtotal is the entire meal total
Add the complete meal again later
Insert zero placeholders

cases.observation: A food identity question remains unanswered.
cases.expect: Keep the meal unresolved and unlogged by default. Do not force an answer or silently finalize it.
forbid: Timeout into guessed intake
State the complete meal was saved

cases.observation: The original pending photo/date is no longer available, or several meals could match.
cases.expect: Ask which original meal/photo/date this answers. Do not promise durable pending-state recovery.
forbid: Attach the reply to an arbitrary meal
Guess yesterday versus today
Invent missing photo content
